column_description: BIGSERIAL. Unique identifier for each usage record. PK.
TEXT. Reference to the environmental reading linked to usage. FK to EnvironmentalReadingsCore.monitor_code.
TEXT. Schedule for rotating artifacts or exhibits. Possible values: Active, Permanent, Resting.
BIGINT. Number of months the artifact or exhibit is displayed. Example: 1.
BIGINT. Number of months the artifact or exhibit is in rest or storage. Example: 22.0.
TEXT. Requirements for displaying the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Custom, Special, Standard.
TEXT. Requirements for storing the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Custom, Special, Standard.
TEXT. Requirements for handling the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Custom, Special, Standard.
TEXT. Transportation requirements for the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Custom, Special, Standard.
TEXT. Packaging requirements for the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Custom, Special, Standard.
TEXT. Restrictions on access to the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Frequent, Occasional, Rare.
TEXT. Public display status of the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Frequent, Occasional, Rare.
TEXT. Frequency of loans for the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Frequent, Occasional, Rare.
TEXT. Frequency of handling the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Frequent, Occasional, Rare.
TEXT. Frequency of documentation updates for the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Frequent, Occasional, Rare.
TEXT. Frequency of monitoring for the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Daily, Monthly, Weekly.
TEXT. Frequency of condition assessments for the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Annually, Monthly, Quarterly.
TEXT. Frequency of conservation treatments for the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Frequent, Occasional, Rare.
TEXT. Frequency of maintenance activities for the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Monthly, Quarterly, Weekly.
TEXT. Frequency of inspections for the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Daily, Monthly, Weekly.
TEXT. Frequency of calibration for monitoring equipment. Possible values: Annually, Monthly, Quarterly.
TEXT. Certification status for the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Current, Expired, Pending.
TEXT. Compliance status for regulations or standards. Possible values: Compliant, Non-compliant, Partial.
TEXT. Audit status for the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Failed, Passed, Pending.
TEXT. Quality status for the artifact or exhibit. Possible values: Failed, Passed, Review.
